leads.name: Ulivo delle Tre Sorelle, Masseria Mozzone, Montalbano di Fasano
leads.reason: Named by italia.it Piana degli Ulivi itinerary (fetched): three trunks from one base, 16.70 m circumference at the base, age not stated. Masseria Mozzone is a hotel/restaurant, Via Lecce 136, 72016 Fasano (italia.it listing), but the listing page says nothing about the tree and no source gives access, a coordinate or a photograph. 16.70 m would be exceptional (sanity check: the figure is the page's alone). Lead: needs the masseria's own word on visits plus a GPS or open photograph.

leads.name: Fasano comune in the national and Puglia registers
leads.reason: Neither data/registers/puglia-alberi-monumentali.json nor italy-masaf.json holds any row in the comune of Fasano (the Puglia list has Ostuni, Carovigno, Ceglie Messapica, Martina Franca, nothing in Fasano), so Fasano has no register-backed candidate. Its olives are covered by the Regione Puglia olive register, which is not open data (see data/leads/ostuni.json finding).
